page.content:
Flank symbol that appears when a pony finds a talent.

How Cutie mark connects

  • Topic: My Little Pony — Cutie marks are the talent-symbols of the My Little Pony world.
  • Work: My Little Pony (G1) — G1 flank symbols became the cutie marks of Friendship Is Magic.

What is Cutie mark?

A cutie mark is the image that appears on a pony's flank when they discover a purpose — Twilight's spark, Rainbow's lightning cloud — the brand idea Bonnie Zacherle's G1 symbols became in Friendship Is Magic.

Key threads lead to My Little Pony and My Little Pony (G1).
